62316.name: Executioner Drive · First Strike
62316.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacking, if in <buf ID=900033>[Stealth]</buf>, this attack's Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+50%</color>. This effect can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per sortie.
At the end of action, if there are no enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles, gains <buf ID=3004502>[Stealth I]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. This effect has a <color=#F74848>3</color>-turn trigger interval.
When actively attacking for the <color=#F74848>1st</color> time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
